Name: Beat 01: Spark / Blow Candle
Comment: Cut on flame extinction at 3.5s. Sound drops instantly to dead vacuum.

Name: Foley: cue_01_ambience
Comment: [A1_Ambience] party_room_tone_chatter.wav: Subdued residential party murmur, gentle clapping, two muffled laughs.

Name: Foley: cue_02_breath
Comment: [A2_Foley] candle_blow_exhale.wav: Focused exhale hiss through pursed lips, ending with candle wick fizzle.

Name: Beat 02: Hard Vacuum / Freeze
Comment: Zero reverb. Total sound kill except high-frequency isolation ring.

Name: Foley: cue_03_vacuum_cutoff
Comment: [A3_SFX] sudden_vacuum_airlock_cutoff.wav: Violent acoustic vacuum pop: room reverberation instantly disappears into total dead silence.

Name: Foley: cue_04_tinnitus_hum
Comment: [A1_Ambience] high_ear_ring_sub_drone.wav: Ultra-faint 14kHz ear-ring tone combined with 40Hz sub-bass pressure thrum.

Name: Beat 03: The First Bite
Comment: Transition from curious calm into mechanical acceleration.

Name: Foley: cue_05_cake_cut
Comment: [A2_Foley] knife_slice_dense_cake.wav: Tactile dull drag of steel blade slicing through dense moist sponge cake.

Name: Foley: cue_06_plate_drop
Comment: [A2_Foley] plate_clink_wet_frosting.wav: Ceramic clink of fork landing, heavy wet slap of buttercream frosting.

Name: Foley: cue_07_first_chew
Comment: [A2_Foley] soft_chew_swallow.wav: Quiet, isolated mouth chew and single gentle swallow in dead room tone.

Name: Beat 04A: Compulsive Feeding
Comment: Ramping foley volume. Metal screech and wet squelch layered over rising pulse.

Name: Foley: cue_08_frenzied_fork
Comment: [A2_Foley] rapid_metal_fork_scraping_porcelain.wav: Harsh high-frequency screech of fork tines scraping frantically against glazed porcelain.

Name: Foley: cue_09_wet_chew
Comment: [A2_Foley] heavy_squelch_wet_chewing_loop.wav: Amplified, hyper-tactile wet squelching of thick sponge cake and shortening frosting in mouth.

Name: Foley: cue_10_heartbeat_rise
Comment: [A3_SFX] muffled_internal_heartbeat_85bpm.wav: Deep thumping internal cardiac pulse filtering into the mix, accelerating.

Name: Beat 04B: Visceral Throat Choke
Comment: Climax of sensory disgust. Infrasound swell cuts abruptly at 24.5s.

Name: Foley: cue_11_enamel_scrape
Comment: [A2_Foley] teeth_enamel_grate_metal.wav: Bone-dry, sickening scrape of front incisor enamel rubbing against stainless steel fork.

Name: Foley: cue_12_choke_swallow
Comment: [A2_Foley] deep_choked_esophagus_swallow.wav: Visceral, heavy wet contraction of throat muscles forcing down dry dense cake mass.

Name: Foley: cue_13_sub_tension
Comment: [A3_SFX] sub_infrasound_swell.wav: Intense 32Hz infrasound wave swelling to peak loudness before the cut.

Name: Beat 05: The Infinite Reset
Comment: Sharp reality snap at 26.0s. Laughter surges back. Loop restarts.

Name: Foley: cue_14_final_swallow
Comment: [A2_Foley] dry_gasp_breath_intake.wav: Violent gasp of air through parted lips, sudden release of jaw tension.

Name: Foley: cue_15_reality_snap
Comment: [A3_SFX] reality_whip_snap_pop.wav: Hyper-sharp whip snap and temporal pop as reality resets.

Name: Foley: cue_16_party_unfreeze
Comment: [A1_Ambience] party_room_laughter_surge.wav: Instant burst of cheerful chatter, laughing voices, and rhythmic party applause.
